g.text: (b) Actual Y = −25 µm slice; alive bonds
Frozen Mode-I geometry and uniform 2 Pa outward traction
5 × 0.4 × 1 mm; Y periodic. Initial pre-crack: 1.50 mm; front X = −1.00 mm.
800 loaded nodes per face × 5 nN = 4 µN per face. Arrow lengths are schematic.
Full fixed reference m; 909,392 reference bonds, 16,416 prescribed initial cuts.
